div.div:
SaaS WORLD
Users have AGENCY (they chose to be here)
Usage = generic proxy for value
Value-proof: cheap, automated, fast
Product teams ship → analytics confirm → done.

div.div:
ENTERPRISE / GOVERNMENT WORLD
Users have NO AGENCY (must use the tax form, the timesheet, the procurement system)
Usage proves NOTHING — there was no choice
Value must be DESCRIBED, not inferred.
